trigger: a fresh deterministic action observation exists for the current run/action/correlation identity
steps: Reject missing, unobserved, stale, cross-run, or cross-correlation action results before semantic evaluation.
Load the declared ontology profile and evaluate functional-property cardinality constraints.
Evaluate class/role disjointness, fixed enumerations, domain/range compatibility, and required current-run references.
On any semantic failure emit cascade.result.rejected, write cascade-post-gate-result, and forbid a success successor.
Only on complete semantic pass emit cascade.result.validated and authorize cascade-emission.
invariants: Structural validity is insufficient for semantic success.
Command acknowledgement or process presence is not ontology/world-state proof.
A post-gate rejection is terminal for the success path and preserves the strongest actually observed proof level.
proofCeiling: Declared ontology/domain coherence of one fresh action result only; no successor delivery or live-target acceptance.
